name: Rings
overview: Scripture reveals that rings in biblical times were significant symbols of honor, authority, and relationship. For example, Pharaoh's act of placing his ring on Joseph's hand signified the bestowal of power and favor (Genesis 41:42), while rings and bracelets were given as pledges and marks of commitment (Genesis 38:18). Rings, often made of gold and precious materials, were also part of the spoils dedicated to the Lord, showing their value and sacred use (Numbers 31:50-51). Additionally, rings and bracelets served as distinguishing adornments for people of rank and were used in sealing decrees, underscoring their role in both social status and official authority.
